notes: Second phone (iPhone 15 Plus / A16), captured with the PocketRoofline iOS app 1.0 (1); raw capture kept unmodified in results/captures/. Single session, back-to-back SISO -> LISO -> SILO, one unrecorded warmup, ~3 s between repeats; no usable network path at any sample (airplane mode), unplugged, Low Power Mode off, battery 60% -> 60%. THREE CAVEATS apply to every figure from this session. (1) WARM START, a METHODOLOGY 5 deviation as in the iPhone 13 session: thermalState was 'fair' at the start; the 10-minute cooldown to 'nominal' was not achieved. (2) APP CAPTURE: the app redraws a live decode chart during each repeat (a new point every 16 generated tokens, inside the timed decode loop); the iPhone 13 harness drew nothing while a repeat ran, so GPU contention from the UI is a possible confound in any comparison between the two phones. (3) UNEXPLAINED SILO STEP: decode fell from 59.17 t/s (last LISO repeat) to 29.69 t/s (first SILO repeat, begun ~3 s later), thermalState 'serious' on both sides, while prefill rose 429.3 -> 465.0 t/s (2048- vs 128-token prompts). That is not a plain thermal decline, and nothing recorded here explains it. A cold-start run with SILO first is owed; until then no peak-to-sustained percentage is quoted for this device, and its SILO figures are not a sustained-throughput estimate. Bandwidth ceiling for this phone is measured, not published: Headroom Metal STREAM triad, median of four probes at 01:05:26-01:05:38Z (this capture is stamped 01:10:56Z, at the end of the run); raw reports in results/bandwidth/.
